description: Primary Stage 4 golden structure benchmark for the 109-page Securities Commission Malaysia AML/CFT/CPF guideline used by the portfolio project. v1.4 expands regression coverage for TOC suppression, numbered hierarchy, callout scope, fragmentation repair, cross-page continuation, appendix hierarchy, figure/text deduplication, and nested enumeration ownership. Version 1.5 adds document-wide parallel-enumeration family and ownership regressions discovered from a fresh end-to-end Stage 4 run. Version 1.6 corrects the semantic contract for nested independent conditional obligations: sentence-complete modal children remain subclauses with parent_of ownership, while dependent phrase/gerund enumerations remain list_items with introduces ownership, independent of page breaks.

policy.required_checks: High-confidence structural invariants. These define regression pass/fail.
policy.advisory_checks: Desired behavior where taxonomy is useful but still under validation. Reported separately.
